description: NexaMusic 0.1.3 Beta — a major lyrics, interface, playback, and performance update.

changelog.title: What's new
items: Introduced Apple Music V3 lyrics as a beta style, with improved typography, spacing, word timing, and smoother lyric auto-scrolling.
Improved duet and multi-vocalist lyric alignment so each singer's lines retain their identity and positioning.
Added animated interlude indicators and refined timed-lyrics rendering.
Refreshed Search colours and Settings icons with a more consistent, colourful Apple Music-inspired appearance.
Restored YouTube Music playlist synchronization in the Library.
Fixed guest playback truncation on streams that do not report their total length.
Improved transition timing and playback handoff behaviour.
Optimized lyrics rendering, Liquid Glass effects, and tab animations to reduce unnecessary work.
Added a sign-in reminder for logged-out users, with a preference to hide it.
Added automatic update checks, beta-release support, background APK downloads, and update notifications.

changelog.title: Notes
items: Apple Music V3 lyrics are still in beta; timing and alignment can vary by track and lyrics provider.
Playlist synchronization requires a signed-in YouTube Music account.
Playback transitions and performance should be verified across different devices and tracks.
